_comment: Registry of retired MacroTilt concepts (indicators, feeds, engines, UI). A name here is DEAD and must not be re-introduced as a producer, registry entry, tracking row, schedule, or live UI surface. Before resurrecting/fixing/registering any of these, the answer is delete the remnant, not revive it (LESSONS 0.10). 'residue' lists code that still references the dead concept and is pending eradication. Created 2026-06-15 cleanup Phase 4.

killed.name: v9 Allocation (legacy)
killed.reason: v10 Allocation fully replaced v9 (V10-ASSET-ALLOCATION 'Replaces the v9 integration'); v10 is independent of v9. Nothing on the live site reads public/v9_allocation.json. Retired the V9-ALLOCATION-WEEKLY job. Joe-approved 2026-06-18.

killed.name: Allocation history (v9 weekly snapshot)
killed.reason: Written only by the v9 weekly job (snapshot of v9_allocation.json); read by no live page. Dead with the v9 system. Joe-approved.
killed.note: Files public/v9_allocation.json + public/allocation_history.json left in repo (harmless static); the producing weekly workflow is deleted so they no longer update.

killed.name: Accounts (user portfolio)
killed.reason: Old live-money Portfolio Insights feed. No live consumer (the /portfolio page was removed; Paper Portfolio replaced it). useUserPortfolio hook orphaned. Manifest-vs-live drift cleanup, Joe-approved 2026-06-17.

Removed manifest entry, tracking row, the close-workflow stamp steps, repair/reconcile entries, and the watchdog mapping. Manifest drift cleanup, Joe-approved.
killed.note: Underlying Supabase table public.portfolio_history left in place (table drop is schema-destructive; needs explicit go from Joe). It is now unproduced, unconsumed, and untracked.

Chase CSV import, position/close editors, the legacy Trading Opps page, portfolio analytics/risk hooks), the nav item, the route, the post-sign-in redirect (now -> Home), and the exclusive risk-proxies producer + workflow + output.

residue: ism tile still wired to the sparse 38-pt ism key instead of the deep ism_mfg (56y)/ism_svc (29y) — REWIRE, do not delete the deep series. Flagged by the new daily reconciler.

killed.name: Editorial commentary chain (macro_commentary / narrative_macro / narrative_sector)
killed.reason: generate-commentary wrote a daily AI macro/sector blurb to macro_commentary + sector_commentary, but NOTHING read those tables: the Home brief and the daily email both come from /daily_brief.json (DAILY-BRIEF-WRITER). The only visible artifact was the watchdog rows going red and putting a stale banner on every page (9-day outage, LESSONS 2026-07-29). Joe approved killing the chain: pg_cron generate-commentary-daily-1130utc unscheduled, watchdog narrative-gap check removed, 3 manifest elements + 3 pipeline_health rows deleted, names in reconciler RETIRED_FEEDS. Tables kept as a frozen archive (no producer).
residue: supabase/functions/generate-commentary/ left deployed-but-unscheduled and in-repo as archive; delete folder if it ever confuses anyone. macro_commentary/sector_commentary tables frozen at 2026-07-28.

killed.name: SPY GICS sector weights (benchmark for tilt deltas)
killed.reason: Never ingested a single row since build (Bug #1087 Phase 1 / Bug #1227): SSGA removed sector values from the public holdings file AND the exact-minute cron gate skipped every run. Zero consumer surfaces in the codebase - the only listed consumer (Asset Tilt sector benchmark) was retired 2026-06-22. Joe-approved retirement 2026-07-29: workflow + ingest script + manifest entry removed, empty table dropped.
